categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three core segments: semiconductor equipment, vacuum and lithium battery equipment, and precision electronic components. Semiconductor equipment includes etching, thin film deposition, furnace tube, cleaning, and crystal growth equipment used in integrated circuits, power semiconductors, compound semiconductors, new displays, and photovoltaic manufacturing. Vacuum and lithium battery equipment focus on high-pressure, high-temperature, and high-vacuum technologies for materials processing in semiconductors, new energy, and advanced ceramics. Precision electronic components include power management chips, quartz crystal devices, sensors, resistors, capacitors, and microwave components serving various industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as inductively coupled plasma (ICP) etching, capacitively coupled plasma (CCP) dielectric etching, physical vapor deposition (PVD), chemical vapor deposition (CVD) including PECVD, SACVD, ALD, and epitaxial growth for various semiconductor materials. It also develops vacuum heat treatment, single crystal growth, and industrial coating equipment using multi-arc ion plating and chemical vapor deposition for new materials like silicon carbide composites. The manufacturing incorporates automation, digitalization, and intelligent manufacturing platforms to ensure high-quality and efficient production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include integrated circuit manufacturers, power semiconductor producers, compound semiconductor fabricators, photovoltaic cell manufacturers, and advanced packaging companies. The company serves industries such as consumer electronics, automotive electronics, industrial electronics, new energy vehicles, photovoltaic energy, and precision electronic components for power electronics, rail transit, smart grids, and precision instrumentation. Major customers are primarily in China, with some exports to Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with significant business in Northeast, North, Central, and Southeast China regions. It has established multiple production and R&D bases in Beijing and surrounding areas. The company also exports photovoltaic equipment to countries including Vietnam, Thailand, Singapore, and Malaysia. Its market presence is predominantly domestic with growing international outreach in Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the semiconductor and electronic components supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying semiconductor fabrication equipment, vacuum and heat treatment equipment, and precision electronic components. It supports upstream semiconductor material processing and downstream device manufacturing by providing critical production tools and components.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous high-intensity R&D investment focused on advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment, expanding product lines, and enhancing core technology capabilities. The company emphasizes innovation in etching, thin film deposition, epitaxial growth, and vacuum technologies. It also focuses on talent development, intelligent manufacturing, market expansion, and operational excellence to maintain competitive advantages and support high-quality growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of semiconductor equipment, vacuum and lithium battery equipment, and precision electronic components. The company recognizes revenue upon transfer of control of goods to customers, based on sales contracts and acceptance. It also earns income from technology services and licensing related to its products. The business model is product sales-centric with supplementary technical support and service revenues.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in China's semiconductor equipment industry, particularly in ICP etching and PVD/CVD equipment. It holds a strong market position with increasing market share in integrated circuit equipment and compound semiconductor equipment. Competitors include other domestic and international semiconductor equipment manufacturers, but the company distinguishes itself through extensive R&D, broad product coverage, and strong customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of approximately 22.08 billion RMB, representing a 50.32% year-over-year increase, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about 3.9 billion RMB, up 65.73%. The company has maintained a compound annual growth rate of 51% in revenue from 2021 to 2023. Total assets reached over 53.6 billion RMB, with net assets of 24.37 billion RMB, reflecting robust growth and expanding scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes customer-centric innovation, delivering high-performance, reliable, and comprehensive semiconductor manufacturing solutions. Its products cover a wide range of critical processes with proprietary technologies, enabling customers to achieve advanced process nodes and high yields. The integration of intelligent manufacturing and quality management systems enhances product delivery and service. The company’s strong R&D capabilities and extensive patent portfolio provide competitive differentiation and long-term customer trust.
